hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: chain of islands in the North Atlantic Ocean, southeast of Florida, northeast of Cuba; note - although The Bahamas does not border the Caribbean Sea, geopolitically it is often designated as a Caribbean nation || long, flat coral formations with some low rounded hills || strategic location adjacent to US and Cuba; extensive island chain of which 30 are inhabited || Resources: salt, aragonite, timber, arable land || Exports: refined petroleum, ships, aluminum, shellfish, plastics (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: long, flat coral formations with some low rounded hills || chain of islands in the North Atlantic Ocean, southeast of Florida, northeast of Cuba; note - although The Bahamas does not border the Caribbean Sea, geopolitically it is often designated as a Caribbean nation

climate.excerpt: tropical marine; moderated by warm waters of Gulf Stream || hurricanes and other tropical storms cause extensive flood and wind damage

economy.excerpt: high-income tourism and financial services economy; major income inequality; strong US bilateral relations; several tax relief programs; targeted investment in agriculture, energy, light manufacturing, and technology industries || Exports: refined petroleum, ships, aluminum, shellfish, plastics (2023) || Industries: tourism, banking, oil bunkering, maritime industries, transshipment and logistics, salt, aragonite, pharmaceuticals
